Marta Lopez: Uploading the updated RFI answers + capability matrix for Pegasus. Key open items: embeddings quota, HSM keywrap details, and POC success criteria. I uploaded two files: /drive/pegasus/rfi/pegasus_rfi_answers_v2.docx and /drive/pegasus/rfi/capability_matrix_pegasus.csv. Need SE + security signoff by EOD Wed. @Jamie @Priya @Devin

Jamie Chen: On it. Quick Q — do they want embeddings on Hosted or Dedicated for the POC? That changes expected QPS and latency targets.

Devin Park: From procurement call: they want to validate hosted first, but will require a Dedicated option for compliance later. For hosted assumptions we should show both per-vector cost and a Dedicated reserved baseline. cc @Marta

Priya Shah: Security note: HSM question in sec questionnaire — we can say "customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM" but need to confirm whether Pegasus requires FIPS 140-2 validated HSM or just equivalent controls. @Marta any intel from procurement?

Marta Lopez: They flagged "FIPS or equivalent" in the questionnaire. Recommend we mark FIPS as conditional and propose Redwood Private with validated HSM as the enterprise offering. POC success criteria (draft): 99th percentile latency < 300ms for single-vector queries, batch embedding throughput >= 5k vectors/min, and correct data residency for EU-only data.

Jamie Chen: Draft RFI language for embeddings — paste below for review:

```
Embeddings: Redwood supports hosted and dedicated deployments. Typical hosted throughput for redwood-embed-lite is ~150 QPS with 99th percentile latencies around 100-150ms (single-vector). For high-throughput/low-latency requirements we recommend Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Redwood Private with HSM integration. Caching and batching may reduce cost per vector. We can provide a POC image and sample load-test scripts upon request.
```

Jamie Chen: Quick excerpt from capability matrix (for the doc):

```
Model,Mode,QPS,99p_latency(ms),Recommended deployment
text-embedding-ada-002,hosted,50,180,Hosted
redwood-embed-lite,hosted,150,120,Hosted (with caching)
redwood-embed-pro,dedicated,500,90,Dedicated (reserved)
```

Jamie Chen: Also pushing a simple loadtest curl example for their infra team to sanity-check: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-lite","input":["a sample sentence"]}'
```

Devin Park: Pricing blurbs to include: Hosted estimate = ~$1.2k/mo for 100k vectors/day (ballpark, depends on batching). Dedicated: propose reserved capacity SKU (monthly commit) — I'll draft two options (small, medium) and an example SOW. Also note: we can include burst credits for first 30 days of the POC.

Priya Shah: For the security answer, use this canonical phrasing unless we need to change it: "Customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or Azure Key Vault; for on-prem deployments Redwood supports standard HSMs via PKCS#11. For FIPS 140-2 validated HSM requirements, we recommend Redwood Private deployed with validated HSM appliances and an appropriate compliance addendum." Use that in the sec questionnaire response.

Marta Lopez: Perfect. Next steps and owners: @Jamie — confirm the latency/QPS numbers and update the CSV matrix by Tue noon. @Priya — finalize HSM and contractual clause by Tue EOD. @Devin — pricing options + SOW draft by Wed. I'll stitch the final RFI packet and send to Pegasus on Thu morning.

Jamie Chen: :thumbsup: Starting load tests now, I'll upload results. Pushed a CSV with sample qps results: /drive/pegasus/poc/loadtest_2026-03-20.csv

Priya Shah: If legal asks for exact language, copy/paste: "Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) for hosted and private deployments. For on-prem or air-gapped environments, Redwood integrates with HSMs via PKCS#11. FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs are supported in Redwood Private deployments and can be included in the contract schedule upon request."

Marta Lopez: Anyone object to me marking this RFI as 'answered-draft' in CRM and sending to procurement once the three owners sign off? If no objections by EOD I'll proceed.

Jamie Chen: No objections.

Devin Park: Go ahead.

rfp-bot: Reminder — attachments larger than 5MB must be shared via S3 link. Created ticket RFC-2026-482 to stage large files for Pegasus.
